notes.title: CONTROLLER SUPPORT
notes.notes:
Added the ability to take control of the mouse cursor with a gamepad. Movement and mouse click can be rebound in keybind settings, and the cursor speed while using controller can be adjusted in the same settings page.
I hope this will allow less able players to enjoy the game!
-a1

notes.title: Achievements Fixed, Added Features ..
notes.notes:
[h3][b]New Feature(s)[/b][/h3]
In [b]Stage Select[/b] it is now possible to [b]hide [/b]stages that have been [b]100% completed[/b].

[h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3]
[b]Tutorial achievement[/b] now [b]works[/b].
One [b]secret achievement[/b] did not work so it has been changed and will [b]properly unlock[/b] now.
They should both [b]unlock[/b] if you have [b]completed[/b] them [b]earlier[/b] without getting the achievement then.

Stage 3 Level 6 has been [b]changed slighty[/b].

Levels that had pre-placed buttons could get other buttons placed within those. This has been fixed.

Completing the tutorial no longer counts towards the Allstar achievement. (It was never supposed to)

[h3][b]Upcoming Changes:[/b][/h3]
[i](These are changes that have not been made, but are on their way)[/i]
Many levels have alternate solutions that are not meant to exist. They will be changed to hopefully only have the correct solution. This [b]will not affect[/b] your level [b]progress[/b] in steam achievements.

Stage 6 will be added once all other mistakes have been corrected.
